highlights.headline: Iran war: US wary of peace plan postponing nuclear deal
highlights.summary: The White House has reportedly not ruled out a proposal from Iran to end its chokehold on the Strait of Hormuz if the US lifts a blockade. However, US officials say any agreement must include a nuclear deal. DW has more.

items.title: Canada's Arctic noise is no party for narwhals
items.description: Known as the "unicorns of the sea," narwhals are fleeing Canada's far north. Researchers suspect a link to noise pollution from increasing ship traffic.

items.title: Fact check: Cloud seeding didn't make it rain in Iran
items.description: Some social media users have claimed the alleged destruction of a climate research center in the United Arab Emirates caused intense precipitation in Iran. But those claims are misleading.
